Process: jero-brain (brain/live.py) (new)

NPU (HTP)
• Whisper base.en / small: speech → text
• ModernBERT int8: text → intent + slots
CPU
• Silero VAD · openWakeWord (always on)
• Piper TTS
• skill executor · Jero link client

I/O: USB lapel mic · booth speaker
Net: → robot UDP 5005, commands 20 Hz
 ← robot UDP 5006, telemetry 10 Hz (new)
Files: whisper/* · intent.onnx (+ QNN context)
 skills.yaml · ~/.config/jero/link.key

Service: jero-walk.service → robot/jero_walk.py
 venv open-duck-mini-runtime · ONNX Runtime (CPU)
Policy: walk.onnx, obs 101 → 14 actions @ 50 Hz

Servos: /dev/ttyACM0 · Waveshare adapter · 1 Mbps
 14× STS3215-C018 · IDs 10–14, 20–24, 30–33
IMU: I²C-1 · MPU6050 0x68 (or BNO055 0x28)
Feet: GPIO 22 / 27 (pull-up, active low)
Extras: eyes GPIO 23/24 · projector GPIO 25
 antennas PWM GPIO 12/13 · MAX98357A I²S amp
Gamepad: Bluetooth (Xbox layout; PS4 mapping to do)

Net: UDP 5005 in (signed commands, TTL 500 ms)
 UDP 5006 out (telemetry 10 Hz) (new)
Files: walk.onnx · duck_config.json · imu.json · link.key" style="rounded=1;arcSize=3;html=0;fillColor=#FFFFFF;strokeColor=#5A9A4F;fontColor=#1A1A1A;fontSize=12;align=left;verticalAlign=top;spacingLeft=12;spacingTop=44;spacingRight=8;" vertex="1" parent="1"><mxGeometry x="660" y="70" width="520" height="330" as="geometry"/></mxCell><mxCell id="pi" value="Pi Zero 2 W · on the robot" style="rounded=0;html=0;fillColor=#5A9A4F;strokeColor=#5A9A4F;fontColor=#FFFFFF;fontSize=14;fontStyle=1;align=left;verticalAlign=middle;spacingLeft=12;" vertex="1" parent="1"><mxGeometry x="660" y="70" width="520" height="34" as="geometry"/></mxCell><mxCell id="pw_b" value="3S Li-ion (11.1 V nominal, 12.6 V full)
→ BMS → main switch, then two branches:
 • servo adapter → 12 V servo bus (14 servos)
 • UBEC 5 V / 3 A → Pi header pin 2 (+) / pin 6 (−)
Check before first power-on: 5.0–5.2 V at the Pi, 11–12.6 V at the adapter" style="rounded=1;arcSize=3;html=0;fillColor=#FFFFFF;strokeColor=#5A9A4F;fontColor=#1A1A1A;fontSize=12;align=left;verticalAlign=top;spacingLeft=12;spacingTop=44;spacingRight=8;" vertex="1" parent="1"><mxGeometry x="660" y="440" width="520" height="160" as="geometry"/></mxCell><mxCell id="pw" value="Robot power" style="rounded=0;html=0;fillColor=#5A9A4F;strokeColor=#5A9A4F;fontColor=#FFFFFF;fontSize=14;fontStyle=1;align=left;verticalAlign=middle;spacingLeft=12;" vertex="1" parent="1"><mxGeometry x="660" y="440" width="520" height="34" as="geometry"/></mxCell><mxCell id="gpu_b" value="Env: uv · JAX cuda12 · mujoco_playground (pinned)

I/O: USB lapel mic · booth speaker
OS: Duck image v0.2.3 (Raspberry Pi OS)
antennas PWM GPIO 12/13 · MAX98357A I²S amp
Gamepad: Bluetooth (Xbox layout; PS4 mapping to do)
Net: UDP 5005 in (signed commands, TTL 500 ms)
Pi Zero 2 W · on the robot
→ BMS → main switch, then two branches:
• servo adapter → 12 V servo bus (14 servos)
• UBEC 5 V / 3 A → Pi header pin 2 (+) / pin 6 (−)
Check before first power-on: 5.0–5.2 V at the Pi, 11–12.6 V at the adapter
Out: deploy_policy.sh (scp → Pi) · intent bundle → RB3
SSH to Pi and RB3 · runs the brain in sim mode
2.4 GHz SSID (Pi Zero 2 W is 2.4 GHz only)
No internet needed at the venue
Never join the venue Wi-Fi; keep the link signed
